prompt: Alkene + mCPBA then H3O+/H2O: cyclohexene is treated with mCPBA (epoxidation), then dilute H2SO4/H2O. Draw the final trans-diol.
explanation: mCPBA gives the epoxide syn across the alkene; acid-catalyzed water opening then goes anti (backside attack). Net: ANTI dihydroxylation → trans-diol. Compare with OsO4 → syn/cis diol. These two methods are the choices for setting diol stereochemistry.
